title: Professional Services (legal, accounting, consulting)
standingRules: Never state legal, tax or financial conclusions in outbound drafts — frame as 'the team will advise'.
Capture referral sources verbatim; referrals are the dominant channel and the referrer gets thanked.
New-client scheduling waits for the conflict-of-interest check unless the profile says otherwise.
compliance: Client communications may be privileged — never quote their content into third-party tools or notifications beyond the firm's own channels.

corridorHints.speed-to-lead: Inquiries often describe sensitive situations; acknowledge carefully, never diagnose.
corridorHints.document-intake: Engagement letters and signed retainers route to the responsible partner, never auto-file.
corridorHints.reporting-autopilot: Report utilization and realization alongside pipeline; partners think in billable terms.
